name: Kenney Nature Kit 2.1
author: Kenney

exclude.cactus_.*|tree_palm.*: Not a woodland plant (desert and beach): kept for a later world
exclude.crops?_.*: Farm crops and field rows: kept for a farm world
exclude.statue_.*: Stone statues, columns and a carved head: ruins, not woods (the head could read as eerie)
exclude.pot_.*|hanging_moss|bed: Not needed in a forest camp (bed_floor is the camp bed that is in)

source: branch asset-packs, folder kenney-nature-kit/ (uploaded by the owner, November 2026)
notes: Nothing in this kit is a weapon or scary. The campfires have no flames.
The kit has no pictures: each material is one plain colour, which FBX2glTF reads too pale, so defaults.colours gives every material its colour (Wild Woods' woodland palette).
Every model sits 0.05 below its own floor: defaults.shift lifts it.

Wild Woods 1.0.0 uses 89 of the 329 models; the rest that are not left out above (the stone cliff set, more rocks, trees, fences, bridges and path tiles) are near-duplicates held back to keep the world small.
